title: FinishLines Creative Concepts | Fabrication & Upholstery, Apopka FL
description: Custom fabrication and marine-grade upholstery for boats and vehicles. Family-run in Apopka, Florida.

blocks.eyebrow: Upholstery × Metal Fab · Apopka, Florida · Family-Run
blocks.text: From custom designs to complete restorations, we bring versatility, professionalism, and quality craftsmanship to every project, big or small.

blocks.headline:
Three trades,
one roof
blocks.intro: Cut, welded, coated & stitched from quote to finish, this family-owned business does it all in‑house.

cards.label: Fabrication
cards.title: Cut, formed & welded
cards.text: CNC plasma, MIG and TIG. Aluminium towers and T-tops, consoles and tanks, gates, railings and cut-metal signage.

cards.label: Upholstery
cards.title: Marine-grade interiors
cards.text: Boats, cars, ATVs and RVs. Diamond stitch, piping and full rebuilds in materials that survive a Florida summer.

cards.label: Powder Coating
cards.title: A finish that outlasts paint
cards.text: Blasted, coated and cured in-house. Resists chips, corrosion and UV, and needs almost no upkeep.

blocks.headline:
More than just a shop:
a family-driven business
paragraphs: At FLCC we're built on craftsmanship, creativity and precision. What started as a passion for rebuilding cars and boats grew into an established local business.
We deliver work that lasts, looks incredible and exceeds expectations, whether that's a full boat interior, a restored classic, or a one-off custom gate.

photo.alt: Restored panel truck with a rebuilt tan diamond-stitched interior
